arguments.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 - <<'PY'
from ebpf.helper import Agent
from syntax import parse_policy
import time,resource
N=16000
a=Agent([{'name':'A','label':1}],{'images':1,'cells':10,'units':2,'contexts':32768,'connections':1,'packets':1,'files':1})
p=parse_policy('startswith() allow;')
def E(e):return a.event(e,parsed=p if e['op']=='stage' else None)
E({'op':'stage','epoch':1,'policy':'startswith() allow;'});E({'op':'commit','epoch':1});E({'op':'spawn','unit':[0,1,1],'service':'A'})
t=time.time()
for rid in range(1,N+1):assert E({'op':'begin','unit':[0,1,1],'rid':rid})['ok']
print('begins',time.time()-t,a.event({'op':'inspect'}))
t=time.time()
for i in range(100000):
 r=E({'op':'clone','parent':[0,1,1],'child':[0,2,2]})
 if not r.get('ok'):print('clone fail',i,r);break
 r=E({'op':'exit','unit':[0,2,2]})
 if not r.get('ok'):print('exit fail',i,r);break
print('100k clone+exit time',time.time()-t)
print('inspect',a.event({'op':'inspect'}))
# child mutation one begin then exit repeated 1000
t=time.time()
for i in range(1000):
 assert E({'op':'clone','parent':[0,1,1],'child':[0,2,2]})['ok']
 r=E({'op':'begin','unit':[0,2,2],'rid':N+1})
 assert r.get('ok'),r
 # parent hasn't used N+1
 r=E({'op':'finish','unit':[0,2,2],'rid':N+1});assert r.get('ok'),r
 assert E({'op':'exit','unit':[0,2,2]})['ok']
print('1000 child-add time',time.time()-t,'rss',resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss)
# parent can now use N+1
print(E({'op':'begin','unit':[0,1,1],'rid':N+1}))
print(a.event({'op':'inspect'}))
PY
